title: Ribbits Programmer Art
description: Makes the Ribbits mod fit in with the Programmer Art style
body:
## Important ⚠️
This rp was created as an integral part of my beta-like [modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/scenery). Please take a look at it
## Why did I do that?
It’s very simple. The old textures are very jagged and unpolished. The Ribbits textures, on the other hand, look like they’re from a completely different game – they’re very smooth and cartoonish. I’ve brought them into line with the overall look
